notes.title: Update notes for May 7
notes.content: - Fixed a trigger playing at the wrong time in the game ending.

notes.title: New Localizations!
notes.content:
[b]We’re adding 11 new languages to the game, so now even more players around the world can jump into Stellarcade Paradise and have some fun.[/b]

The new languages are:
Arabic
Chinese (Simplified)
French
German
Indonesian
Japanese
Korean
Polish
Thai
Turkish
Vietnamese

Let’s go!

notes.title: LASER TAG MASSACRE OST IS AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
As a thank you, we’re excited to present you the long-requested Laser Tag Massacre OST! We teamed up with the amazing GTNK, who composed an entire album of original music for the game. LTM now has its very own official soundtrack! We hope that you like!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3624540/Laser_Tag_Massacre_Soundtrack/]LASER TAG MASSACRE OST[/url]

notes.title: LASER TAG MASSACRE RELEASED!
notes.content: [b]Laser Tag Massacre[/b] is officially released on Steam! Thank you all for your patience — this is our first full project, and we couldn't have done it without your support. Thank you for helping us make our dream come true. We're incredibly proud of this achievement!

notes.title: Teaser DEMO is OUT!
notes.content:
Good evening!

The free [b]DEMO[/b] of [b]Laser Tag Massacre[/b] is now available for download here on Steam!

It’s a short teaser, but a great way to introduce the characters and set the tone for what’s coming next. We hope you enjoy it!

[b]A huge thank you to everyone adding the game to their Wishlist.[/b] This is our first release on Steam, and we’re really excited about it! ❤️

[i]Pedro Luz - Liminal Road[/i]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3579960/Laser_Tag_Massacre/]LASER TAG MASSACRE[/url]
